left.title: magellan mapsend lakes (usa south)
left.description: magellan mapsend lakes usa - south includes fishing hot spots(fhs) maps of some of the most famous tournament fishing lakes in the united states. there is no lakemaster content in the south region but it contains almost as much lake data as the north region. the south region detail lakes are mostly big water impoundments on the major tennessee valley river systems and many other major lakes elsewhere in the covered area including respectable coverage of texas arkansas missouri and florida lakes mapped by fhs. you wont want to be without mapsend lakes if you are fishing these big reservoirs and lakes.mapsend lakes south also includes basic surface maps of larger lakes and rivers based on usgs data. mapsend lakes usa - south is available on a pre-loaded sd memory card for use on a compatible magellan gps receiver. - detailed fishing hot spots maps in the southern u.s. with depth contours and underwater structure lake access services and more. fhs maps include lake profiles. many show marked fishing areas with fishing tips. - basic surface mapping of many more lakes and reservoirs. - basemap of roads and highways plus extensive searchable points of interest (poi) from the u.s. geological survey. lakes al: guntersville lake pickwick lake wheeler lake ar:beaver lake dardanelle lake greers ferry lake lake ouachita millwood lake norfork lake fl: east lake tohopekaliga harris lake chain lake george lake kissimmee lake okeechobee lake talquin lake tohopekaliga rodman res
